title: Ondo principles accordion row
description: A black band with a photo fading into it behind a two-tone white heading, then a row of rounded cards running off the right edge: the open card is white and wide (number in a ring, title, serif sentence, a rule and a partner name), the rest are narrow near-black cards outlined in faint white with just a number and a title at the foot. Arrows or a click open the next card: it widens while the row slides left and its text fades up.
notes: media slot: the photo or video behind the heading; a plain surface fading to black when empty
forces the theme's dark colours with the dark class (the original band is black on a white page)
descriptions read var(--ondo-serif) and fall back to the display face in other themes
name: ondo-principles

props.name: media
props.description: the photo or video behind the heading. A plain surface when empty
